title: Annual coverage review checklist
summary: Twelve questions we go through with every client once a year. Use it before your renewal.
body:
1. Has anything been built, finished or renovated?
  2. New car, new driver, or a driver who moved out?
  3. Any jewelry, art or equipment worth more than $2,500?
  4. Do you rent out any part of a property?
  5. Any new dog, pool, trampoline or wood stove?
  6. Has anyone started a business from home?
  7. Has your income or net worth changed enough to revisit the umbrella?
  8. Is the mortgagee on the policy still correct?
  9. Are you within a mile of the river or in a low spot?
  10. When did you last check the rebuild estimate?
  11. Are beneficiaries on life policies current?
  12. Do your deductibles still match your savings?

title: Home inventory in 30 minutes
summary: A room-by-room method using a phone video. The single most useful thing to have after a theft or fire.
body:
Walk each room with your phone recording. Open closets and drawers. Narrate brand names and rough ages. Store the video somewhere other than the house.

Then, once

List items worth over $500 with receipts or photos of serial numbers.

title: Winter freeze checklist
summary: Pipes freeze in the same places every year. Ten minutes in November prevents most of it.
body:
• Disconnect hoses and shut off outdoor spigots
  • Insulate pipes along exterior walls
  • Keep the heat at 55°F or above when away
  • Know where the main shut-off is, and label it
  • Consider a water sensor near the water heater

title: How certificate of insurance requests work
summary: What to send us, what we can add, and how fast it comes back.
body:
Email the requester's name, address and the contract language that names them. Most certificates go out the same business day from the Larch Ferry office.

What a certificate cannot do

It cannot add coverage you do not have. If a contract requires an additional insured endorsement or a waiver of subrogation, we add it to the policy first.

title: Workers' comp payroll audit prep
summary: The six documents auditors ask for, and how to split payroll by class code.
body:
1. Quarterly payroll tax filings
  2. Payroll register by employee
  3. Job descriptions for each role
  4. Certificates of insurance from subcontractors
  5. Overtime totals (often excluded at the premium rate)
  6. Owner payroll election, if any

Subcontractors without their own certificate are usually counted as your payroll.
